skip.source_cn: 消除赤烛蕊毒性的效果来自飞蛾的鳞粉。想要彻底消除整片花海的毒性，只凭飞蛾肯定需要花上很长一段时间，制成药剂是一个好方法。

en.text: The moths' wing scales neutralize Candle Blossom's poison. Relying on moths alone would take too long to cleanse the entire field, so making a potion seems the better approach.
